title: IIT Hyderabad Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Project Associate Posts
description: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Hyderabad) has released the official notification for the recruitment of various Project Associate Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering, or any degree, can use this chance and apply for these posts. Here we have included more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Notification 2026 .
